claims.object_text: Kv1.2, the alpha subunit of a Shaker-like voltage-dependent potassium channel with high expression in the mammalian thalamocortical system.
claims.quote: Kcna2 codes for Kv1.2, the alpha subunit of a Shaker-like voltage-dependent potassium channel with high expression in the mammalian thalamocortical system.
we studied sleep in Kcna2 knockout (KO) mice.
KO pups die by P28 due to generalized seizures.

claims.object_text: significantly less non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep (-23%)
claims.quote: KO pups have significantly less non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep (-23%)
and significantly more waking (+21%) than HZ and WT siblings

claims.object_text: no change in rapid eye movement (REM) sleep time
claims.quote: with no change in rapid eye movement (REM) sleep time.

claims.object_text: decrease in NREM sleep is due to an increase in the number of waking episodes, with no change in number or duration of sleep episodes
claims.quote: The decrease in NREM sleep is due to an increase in the number of waking episodes, with no change in number or duration of sleep episodes.

claims.object_text: seizures are either absent or very rare at P17 (< 1% of the 24-h recording time)
claims.quote: At P17 seizures are either absent or very rare in KO pups (< 1% of the 24-h recording time)

claims.object_text: regulates neuronal excitability and affects NREM sleep
claims.quote: Kv1.2, a mammalian homologue of Shaker, regulates neuronal excitability and affects NREM sleep.
